description: Defines the 'agriculture.TernaryPlot' class for rendering a soil composition ternary plot using SVG and Snap.svg library, including methods for creating SVG elements, configuring plot parameters, drawing soil type polygons, labels, legend, and interactive blip markers.

classes.name: TernaryPlot
classes.description: Class for rendering and interacting with a soil composition ternary plot using SVG graphics.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the TernaryPlot instance, loads SVG library, and sets up the plot.

methods.name: make_svg
methods.description: Creates the SVG element for the plot.

methods.name: init_config
methods.description: Sets up plot configuration, including soil type coordinates and colors.

methods.name: get_coords
methods.description: Returns coordinate points for a specified soil type polygon.

methods.name: get_color
methods.description: Returns color for a specified soil type.

methods.name: make_plot
methods.description: Draws soil type polygons on the SVG.

methods.name: make_plot_marking
methods.description: Adds labels for soil types on the plot.

methods.name: make_legend
methods.description: Creates a legend for soil types.

methods.name: mark_blip
methods.description: Places a marker (blip) on the plot based on soil composition.

methods.name: remove_blip
methods.description: Removes the blip marker from the plot.
